_draft: DRAFT — not committed. No metrics, none are known. Serbian drafted by Claude, needs review. case_study can only hold ONE reference but this role has three published case studies — see chat.
bullets_en: Built and released a Terms and Conditions micro frontend, moving it out of an application that held several unrelated concerns and off an end-of-life framework version.
Migrated two applications from Vue 2 to Vue 3, working around an internal dependency that had no Vue 3 release rather than waiting for one.
Evaluated two spec-driven development frameworks on real migration work and presented a recommendation to the team.

Took over a chatbot application from another team: consolidated it from several repositories, obtained the access and credentials the team needed to run it, tested it for release, and presented its architecture to my team and beyond.
Replaced free-text confirmations in the chatbot with explicit confirm and cancel buttons, so a user's intent could no longer be misread before a live setting changed.
bullets_sr: Izrada i izdanje mikro-frontend aplikacije za uslove korišćenja, izdvojene iz aplikacije koja je sadržala više nepovezanih namena i sa verzije radnog okvira kojoj je istekla podrška.
Prelazak dve aplikacije sa Vue 2 na Vue 3, uz zaobilaženje interne zavisnosti koja nije imala izdanje za Vue 3, umesto čekanja na njega.
Procena dva radna okvira za razvoj vođen specifikacijom na stvarnom poslu migracije i predstavljanje preporuke timu.

Preuzimanje chatbot aplikacije od drugog tima: objedinjavanje iz više repozitorijuma, obezbeđivanje pristupa i pristupnih podataka potrebnih timu za pokretanje, testiranje pred izdanje i predstavljanje arhitekture mom timu i šire.
Zamena potvrda u vidu slobodnog teksta u chatbotu izričitim dugmadima za potvrdu i otkazivanje, čime se namera korisnika više ne tumači pogrešno pre izmene aktivnog podešavanja.
